faqItems.duur_q: How long does the Scorecard really take?
faqItems.duur_a: Twelve minutes on average. Four sections, fifteen questions. You can pause in between — your answers are saved locally and remain available as soon as you reopen the page.
faqItems.voor-wie_q: What type of firm is the Scorecard designed for?
faqItems.voor-wie_a: Specifically for European regional PE funds, M&A firms and entrepreneurs in the lower mid-market (deals €1M–€25M). Not for startups, not for large corporates, not for firms outside this segment.
faqItems.vertrouwelijk_a: Completely. Your answers are not shared, not sold, not used for benchmarks without anonymisation. You can fill it in anonymously if you wish — your name is only requested when you receive the report.
faqItems.onderbouwing_q: What is the basis for the six dimensions?
faqItems.onderbouwing_a: The dimensions come from hands-on experience in acquisition finance and financial restructuring. The reference level per dimension is our own target — the point at which a dimension is instrumented well enough to steer on. It is not a measured market average, and we do not pretend otherwise.
faqItems.wie_a: Wouter Dijkman, founder. Acquisition finance and financial restructuring, European mid-market.
faqItems.sales-pitch_q: Is this just another disguised sales pitch?
faqItems.sales-pitch_a: No. You receive scores across six dimensions, two priority focus points and a concrete next-step proposal. Only then do you decide whether to continue. No pressure, no follow-up unless you initiate it yourself.
faqItems.investering_q: What are the investment levels for the different tracks?
faqItems.investering_a: There are four routes: a free AI Sparring Session (20 minutes, no obligation), AI Advisory & Implementation from €4,500 per track or retainer, a Fractional AI Officer for €1,099 per day (min. 3 months), and AI-driven Due Diligence & Portfolio from €10,000 per deal or from €6,500 per month for ongoing portfolio intelligence. All amounts excluding VAT. See /werkwijze for the full explanation.
faqItems.voorbeeld_q: What if I don't want to fill in the Scorecard but do want to see the report format?
faqItems.voorbeeld_a: Send a message via LinkedIn or email. We'll then send you an anonymised sample report.

bio.para2_prefix: Agentic Mindshift launched in October 2025. In November 2025 followed AI for Business at Nyenrode. In development is
bio.para2_suffix: : an AI platform with modules that let deal teams systematically instrument their DD process, monthly reporting and judgement formation.
bio.para3: I'm building this deliberately selectively: a handful of partners at a time, so every engagement stays hands-on and the work gets the attention a deal deserves.

faq.heading: What partners typically want to know first
faq.q1: What if it turns out not to be right for us?
faq.a1: Start with an AI Sparring Session: one question, one summary, no follow-up obligation.
faq.a2: Deal experience in acquisition finance and financial restructuring: not an AI generalist who happens to have PE clients. AI strengthens that practice; it does not replace it.
faq.q3: How do I know whether the investment delivers a return?
faq.a3: Worked example: one missed correction to the acquisition price outweighs years of advisory fees, and a single deviation flagged in time in the monthly reporting often covers the annual cost of ongoing portfolio insight on its own. The full worked example with figures is on the homepage.
faq.q4: Are we locked in to a long duration?
faq.a4: Sparring, Consultancy and DD are per engagement. Fractional AI Officer: minimum 3 months, because the rhythm needs time.
faq.a5: Yes. Multiple deals qualify for tiered rates — we align these with your dealflow during the introduction. The scale advantage sits in onboarding time and platform onboarding.

privacy.meta_description: Privacy statement of Agentic Mindshift. GDPR-compliant, transparent and limited in data collection.
privacy.heading: Privacy Statement
privacy.intro: This privacy statement explains what personal data Agentic Mindshift collects, for what purpose, on what legal basis, how long it is retained and what rights you have. The policy is aligned with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy.s1_body: The controller for processing is Agentic Mindshift, established in the Netherlands. Contact person: Wouter Dijkman, reachable at wouter@agenticmindshift.nl.
privacy.s2_body: We collect only the data you actively provide: your name, business email address, company name, job title, optional telephone number, and your answers on the scorecard. We also process technical data such as IP address and user agent in standard hosting logs.
privacy.s3_li1: Generating and sending your personal scorecard report — performance of contract.
privacy.s3_li2: Two follow-up emails (after three and seven days) with substantive reflection and an invitation for a sparring session — legitimate interest.
privacy.s3_li3: Managing a waitlist for Factum Capital — performance of contract or your explicit consent.
privacy.s3_li4: Analysing aggregated, non-traceable scorecard outcomes to improve the reference levels — legitimate interest.
privacy.s4_body: Your scorecard answers and report data are retained for a maximum of 36 months, unless you request earlier deletion. Waitlist data for Factum Capital is retained until six months after launch, then anonymised.
privacy.s5_body: We use a limited number of processors: Supabase (European region) for data persistence, Resend for sending emails and a European hosting provider for the website. A data processing agreement has been concluded with each processor.
privacy.s6_body: By default your data is stored and processed within the European Union. Should transfer outside the EU occur, it takes place exclusively on the basis of the standard contractual clauses of the European Commission.
privacy.s7_body: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection. A request can be directed to wouter@agenticmindshift.nl. You may also lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority.
privacy.s8_body: The website uses only functional cookies and local storage (localStorage) for the interim saving of your scorecard answers. No tracking cookies or advertising cookies are used.
privacy.s9_body: We reserve the right to amend this statement. The most current version is always on this page.

voorwaarden.heading: Terms and Conditions
voorwaarden.s1_body: In these terms "Agentic Mindshift" means the sole tradership of Wouter Dijkman, established in the Netherlands. "Client" means the natural or legal person who places an engagement or makes use of the website or scorecard.
voorwaarden.s2_body: These terms apply to all use of the website agenticmindshift.nl, to the Scorecard, and to all engagements in which Agentic Mindshift acts as contractor. Deviations apply only if agreed in writing.
voorwaarden.s3_body: Engagements are carried out as best-efforts obligations, unless explicitly agreed otherwise. The scorecard is a diagnostic tool and does not constitute investment or financial advice. The content of reports and sparring sessions does not constitute advice within the meaning of the Financial Supervision Act.
voorwaarden.s4_body: Fees are listed on the "How We Work" page and are exclusive of VAT unless stated otherwise. Invoicing takes place monthly in advance for retainer engagements and upon delivery for projects. Payment term: thirty days net.
voorwaarden.s5_body: Retainer engagements have a minimum duration of six months and are thereafter terminable monthly with a notice period of one month. AI-driven Due Diligence engagements may be cancelled without charge up to three working days after confirmation. Workshops are non-cancellable within ten working days before the agreed date.
voorwaarden.s6_body: The liability of Agentic Mindshift is limited to the invoice amount of the engagement in question over a period of a maximum of three months, with a maximum of 25,000 euro. Liability for indirect damage, consequential loss, loss of profit or missed IRR is excluded.
voorwaarden.s7_body: All information shared in the context of an engagement or sparring session is treated as confidential. This applies without end date. Aggregated, non-traceable data may be used to improve the reference levels.
voorwaarden.s8_body: Reports, frameworks and analyses remain the intellectual property of Agentic Mindshift, unless agreed otherwise. The client receives a non-transferable right of use for internal purposes.
voorwaarden.s9_body: These terms and all engagements are governed by Dutch law. Disputes are submitted to the competent court in the district of establishment.
